We'll build the regeneration and sprout Methods around the measurements and
models used in the accepted displays. The planned 1–1.5-page subsection should
explain how the reported quantities are estimated, with expanded comparisons
and secondary species detail linked in the supplement. That keeps the route
from field observations to reported estimates easy to follow.

For sprout heights, the [RD03 review and proposal](task-rd03.qmd#rd03-model-plan)
now identify the selected-clump sampling target, four-site treatment replication,
shared year-5 measurement in adjacent increments, and the distinction between
zero-effect and integrated predictions. These choices remain under review;
the final Methods must follow the selected model and prediction target.
